rtlDecisions.action: Placed brand at the right and navigation entries after it in RTL flex order.

rtlDecisions.what: Project title, tags, summary and metadata
rtlDecisions.action: Anchored text to the right; set RTL text direction and moved the expand action to the left end of its strip.
rtlDecisions.why: These are reading-order page elements; the secondary action belongs at the far end.

rtlDecisions.action: Ordered tabs and controls from the right; placed the title column on the right and status, type, owner and update date successively to its left.
rtlDecisions.why: This is a Persian data table, so category order and text start at the right. Numeric date digits retain their normal sequence.

rtlDecisions.what: Five row slots and flyer x coordinates
rtlDecisions.action: Kept layout.detail slot x/y/w/h and centered 1104px page width unchanged; rebuilt each row's content in RTL order and reused that same component in the flyer.
rtlDecisions.why: The page area is centered and the slots are vertically stacked. Their screen coordinates carry no left/right reading meaning, while content inside each slot does. Identical DOM avoids a crop/repaint mismatch.

rtlDecisions.what: Row descent, rotateX, scale and shadow
rtlDecisions.action: Preserved perspective(900px), translateY(-120*air), rotateX(16*air), scale settle, cue=12+i*9, 12-frame flight and 4-frame settle.
rtlDecisions.why: They express gravity and physical embedding rather than reading direction.

rtlDecisions.action: Matched the patch to the exact row slot bounds and page paper color; retained its original two-frame fade after landing.
rtlDecisions.why: It must hide the destination row until the flyer lands without leaving the earlier bright slab.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept its 2px bottom edge, center-out five-frame spread, eight-frame fade and original easing.
rtlDecisions.why: The landing flash is symmetric and physical.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept cx=960, cy=300→760, zoom=1.1→1 and the upstream interpolation/easing in the card-local camera.
rtlDecisions.why: The pan is vertical and independent of reading direction.

rasterHandling.handling: Removed from the rendered scene and replaced with a live Persian detail page. No raster screenshot or crop remains.
rasterHandling.reason: The original image baked in Chinese and English UI copy; blurring it erased the legibility central to this card.

components.timing: Persian strings differ in length, but rows animate as whole cards. Original cue, landing, seam, camera and 68-frame duration values are unchanged, so text length does not shift any beat.
concerns: The source screenshot's fine type metrics cannot be matched exactly with a new Persian font; the content geometry, row slots, warm palette and animation beats are retained.
During flight, a row can temporarily overlap its destination and nearby content. This also occurs in the upstream effect and resolves on landing.
lessons: A heavily blurred baked page cannot serve as a localized background when the animation is about rows embedding into readable UI. Rebuild the page and flying rows with one shared live component, then use the original slot coordinates and timing.

visualVerification.result: Viewed original and Persian frames at setup, successive flights/landings and the final rest. Persian text remains legible, the page and table read RTL, the row copies align with their slots, and no baked foreign text is rendered.
